notes.title: Check out our first devlog on the idea behind Unshaken
notes.content:
Hey! Zoe and I (Jeremy) would like to thank you for checking out and (hopefully) wishlisting Unshaken! We are a brother and sister indie team trying to build the fantasy game we've always wanted to play.

We’re trying to build a playable version in… 90 days. No sweat, right? With that in mind, we had the goal of publishing a Steam page with real gameplay just 30 days after the start line to start getting feedback as early as possible. It's kind of hard to believe but we actually did it! We even have a little trailer to go with it.

We'd love your feedback. Which pieces are resonating? Which parts aren't? We'd love to hear your ideas for the game too. We're collaborating and brainstorming in our build-in-public [url=https://discord.gg/a4U4cg5pNh]Discord [/url] so feel free to jump into the discussion.

We also are starting a devlog series to chronicle progress and talk about big decisions we are making. The first one covers the idea for the game. We'd love to hear how we can make these devlogs more interesting for y'all, so susbcribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4zLbKx28acJApX9A8McQdg]channel [/url]and give us feedback.

Without further ado, the first devlog (note, this was filmed 3 weeks ago so we've made a bunch of progress since then as evidenced by the trailer and screenshots on our new Steam page):
